core_meaning.short_meaning: Pardoning, forgiving; a divine name in the Qur'an
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Afuw (العفو) is a divine name meaning “the Pardoner” or “the One who effaces faults”. It occurs in the Qur'an in verses including 4:99 and 4:149. The root ع ف و carries senses of pardon, effacement and abundance; the name is used, though less commonly, as a male given name.
